profile.headline: Software Engineer at WebBank
profile.summary:
I learned how to code from DevMountain (a local institution that teaches web development) where I learned Javascript, Angular, React, Node, Express, SQL, HTML/CSS, Gulp, Git and JQuery.

Prior to that, I was the lead designer of a web based enterprise level warehouse management system. In doing so, I have worked with a team to revamp old ideas as well as implement new ones that would streamline the flow and give the best user experience for our customers.

I have been in the software industry for 7 years and have enjoyed the challenges and satisfaction it provides.  I'm looking to increase my coding knowledge and make applications that will help people do what they need to do.

positions.description: Frontend development for internal application s. Utilizing React, Vue, AWS web services, Sonar Cloud, Snyk, and Tableau.

positions.title: Web Developer - Fullstack Application Including AngularJS | Node |Express | SQL
positions.description:
All The Things - Web application build to help manage all the items in your home.
URL ►https://allthethings.herokuapp.com/

• Built with Angular, Node, Express, SQL. 
• Auth0 login system.
• Ability to scan basic barcodes with built-in webcam.
• Custom grid operations | show/hide columns | sort/filter columns | rearrange columns

positions.title: Software Designer | IT
positions.description:
Design:
•Work with content experts and clients to assemble requirements for the evolution of the software.
•Rapid prototype features for their iterative development process.
•Generate specification documents
•Research new and existing technologies to accommodate design and feature requirements.
•Competitive analysis
•Create assets and layout libraries
•Focus group and survey testing

IT:
•Assembled hardware and setup development environments using automated scripts
•Wrote and implemented automated deployment scripts
•Wrote and implemented automated server run-time environments
•Set up cloud infrastructure using Hyper-V and Windows Server
•General troubleshooting of hardware, software, databases, and networking

positions.title: Associate Producer
positions.description:
Associate Producer
•Organized sprint tasks and managed weekly sprints
•Planned, organized and managed using the AGILE process
•Tracked and maintained feature and bug databases
•Implemented and planned out designs and features
•Oversaw feature implementation and made priority decisions
•Developed road maps and completion plans
•Organized work flow
•Managed Art, Developer, Community, QA and Design team

Designer
•Created feature improvements and new designs to monetize.
•Wrote design documents
•Organized resource requirements and time estimates

Artist
•Adjusted current assets to match a universal design
•Created new assets using Photoshop and Flash

positions.title: Quality Assurance Lead
positions.description:
Quality Assurance Lead on Risk: Factions (Facebook)
•Created and modified testing plan templates.
•Updated process for certification and Facebook platform approvals.
•Developed new procedures for billing, analytics and community feedback. 
•Hired, trained and managed testing teams in Salt Lake City, San Francisco, and China.
•Maintained bug tracking database, wrote test cases and coordinated testing assignments.
•Pitched and implemented ideas on how to improve gameplay, including feature design, game balance, and additions to the microtransaction economy.
•Organized weekly meetings with production team to update them on current bug trends and provide QA feedback on upcoming features.

projects.title: Family Village
projects.description: A city builder style Facebook game about family and genealogy.

projects.description: The board game Risk, on Facebook.
